description: Search React Native / Expo motion components by interaction pattern, app screen, or natural-language intent (for example, a tracker, settings screen, login, or pricing screen). No login needed. Results include price, dependencies, SDK, platforms, and match evidence. Demo content is one use case; call get_piece to check the actual customization props and data model before selecting or integrating a component. Use tag, free_only, and exclude_dependencies as hard filters. Default limit 10, maximum 20. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor with the same query and filters to continue. An empty query returns a catalog page and type/tag facets. If a search returns no matches, browse anonymous Base options with list_blocks and list_family.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same query, filters and catalog version.

exclude_dependencies.description: Exclude pieces requiring any listed package, e.g. @shopify/react-native-skia.

query.description: Uses the first 120 characters and 12 significant concepts; excess is ignored with truncated: true. Free text, e.g. "3d carousel", "otp input", "glass tab bar".

name: search_pieces
title: Search animations
